key.name: font
key.summary: A Pango font name and size

key.name: custom-font
key.summary: Whether to use a custom font

key.name: bright-colors-for-bold
key.summary: Whether to use bright colors for bold text in the terminal.
key.description: If true, bold text is rendered in bright colors instead.

key.name: scrollback-lines
key.summary: Number of lines to keep in scrollback
key.description: Number of scrollback lines to keep around. You can scroll back in the terminal by this number of lin es; lines that don’t fit in the scrollback are discarded.

key.name: login-shell
key.summary: Whether to launch the command in the terminal as a login shell
key.description: If true, the command inside the terminal will be launched as a login shell (argv[0] will have a hyphen in front of it).

key.name: exit-action
key.summary: What to do with the terminal when the child command exits
key.description: Possible values are “close” to close the terminal, “restart” to restart the command, and “hold” to keep the terminal open with no command running inside.

key.name: show-help-terminal
key.summary: Show terminal with help message at start
key.description: If true, 2 terminals are spawned at initialization, one of them with a list of shortcuts.

key.name: dropdown-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut to show/hide the drop down terminal
key.description: Global shortcut handled by the Batata GNOME Shell extension to toggle the drop down terminal.

key.name: dropdown-monitor
key.summary: Monitor where the drop down terminal is shown
key.description: “primary” for the primary monitor, “pointer” for the monitor under the mouse pointer or a monitor connector name (e.g. “DP-1”).

key.name: ask-to-enable-extension
key.summary: Ask to enable the Batata GNOME Shell extension
key.description: If true, Batata asks to enable its GNOME Shell extension at start when it's installed but disabled.
